TGO.note: No consumer rules or complaints body stated.

facts.fact: Republique Togolaise reports the Caisse de Retraites du Togo announced it will end cash pension payments at its counters from July 2026 and pay by mobile money (Mixx by Yas, Flooz) or bank transfer, asking cash pensioners to supply phone or bank identity details.
facts.system: CRT pension payment by mobile money or bank transfer

TGO.note: Mobile money providers are named only as pension channels from July 2026; the document does not say their service is in service.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
